description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different source types—Tutorials (blue), Library Documentation (red), StackOverflow posts (yellow), and Github files (green)—as measured by a metric (likely accuracy or relevance score) across increasing numbers of retrieved tokens, ranging from 200 to 1000 on the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled with values from 10 to 40, represents the performance score. Tutorials (blue line with circle markers) show a steady increase from approximately 23 at 200 tokens to 29 at 800 tokens, then slightly decline to 28 at 1000 tokens. Library Documentation (red line with circle markers) starts at 26, rises to 32 at 800 tokens, and drops to 27 at 1000 tokens. StackOverflow posts (yellow line with circle markers) begin at 33, decline steadily to 19 at 1000 tokens, showing the steepest downward trend. Github files (green line with circle markers) start at 28, rise to 33 at 800 tokens, and then fall slightly to 30 at 1000 tokens. All lines are solid, and the plot includes a legend in the top-left corner identifying each source type by color and marker.
